name: scenario_0508
description: The user is organizing their activism research tasks and has photos of various campaign materials. They want to set up a workspace in their task manager and extract only the UK-based campaigns to research further.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1
Query: I'm setting up my workspace for activism research. Please create a Todoist project called 'Activism 2026' with a section named 'UK Campaigns'. Also, set a reminder for tomorrow at 10:00 AM to 'Process campaign photos'.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to create a Todoist project called 'Activism 2026' with a section called 'UK Campaigns', and to set a reminder for tomorrow at 10:00 AM to process campaign photos. If the assistant asks for any other details, tell it that is all you need for now. Once the assistant confirms the project, section, and reminder have been created successfully, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3]
Query: Here are the campaign photos I need to process. Please filter them to identify only the campaigns based in the UK by checking for '.uk' in their URLs or UK locations like London. For each matching campaign, add a task under the 'UK Campaigns' section of my Activism project to research them, including their organization name and URL in the task description.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to review the provided images, identify the UK-based campaigns based on your criteria ('.uk' in the URL or UK locations), and create a research task for each match under the 'UK Campaigns' section of your Activism project. Specify that the task description must include the organization's name and URL. If the assistant asks which 'Activism' project to use (since there is an older 2025 one on the device), clarify that you mean the 'Activism 2026' project you just created. If the assistant mistakenly includes the wildlife campaign, correct it by pointing out that it lacks any UK indicators. Once the correct tasks are added, you can end the conversation.

You have 3 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
IMPORTANT: Image IDs are ZERO-INDEXED integers (0, 1, 2, ...). Do NOT add 1 to the IDs.
Available image IDs: [0, 1, 2]
Image mapping:
  image_1.jpg -> image ID 0
  image_2.jpg -> image ID 1
  image_3.jpg -> image ID 2

## IMAGE DELIVERY

⚠️ IMPORTANT: You MUST use the `send_message_with_image` tool to share images with User B. Do NOT just describe images in text — you MUST call the tool.

Image delivery schedule:

  Round 2: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='0,1,2' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.
